verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Glama serves a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.3 spec at /api/mcp/openapi.json describing the platform API, plus an RFC 9727 api-catalog linkset for discovery, though an earlier probe found the naive /openapi.json path 404s. missing for 10: no first-party docs page linking/announcing the spec, and no independent/community confirmation of using it to generate a client.
